program_narrative: Program RPTSTA00 is a batch program that is meant to produce the system statistics and performance report. It opens DB2-STATS and BATCH-STATS for input and REPORT-FILE for output, writes three header lines (asterisks, the title 'SYSTEM STATISTICS AND PERFORMANCE REPORT' and the system date) and clears the performance accumulators. It then reads DB2-STATS sequentially to end of file and BATCH-STATS sequentially to end of file, performing an accumulation paragraph for each record, then performs metric calculation and report-writing paragraphs; none of those seven paragraphs (2110-ACCUMULATE-DB2-STATS, 2210-ACCUMULATE-BATCH-STATS, 2310-CALC-DB2-METRICS, 2320-CALC-BATCH-METRICS, 2410-WRITE-DB2-SECTION, 2420-WRITE-BATCH-SECTION, 2430-WRITE-TREND-ANALYSIS) exists in the source, so what is accumulated, calculated and written is unknown. The record layouts of DB2-STATS and BATCH-STATS are also incomplete: COPY DB2STAT names a program, not a copybook. Finally it closes the three files and returns. Error conditions handled: a failed OPEN displays an error message, sets return code 12 and ends the program; end of file ends each read loop.

OPEN DB2-STATS for READ-ONLY
IF db2_stats_status (WS-DB2-STATUS) != '00' THEN  -- '00' = successful open

  CALL 9999-error-handler  -- ends the program (GOBACK)
END IF
OPEN BATCH-STATS for READ-ONLY
IF batch_stats_status (WS-BCH-STATUS) != '00' THEN
  SET error_message = 'ERROR OPENING BATCH STATS'
  CALL 9999-error-handler  -- ends the program (GOBACK)
END IF
OPEN REPORT-FILE for WRITE (new)
IF report_status (WS-REPORT-STATUS) != '00' THEN
  SET error_message = 'ERROR OPENING REPORT FILE'
  CALL 9999-error-handler  -- ends the program (GOBACK)
END IF
